note: This task's Hub starts EMPTY -- upstream's preprocess deletes the repository the agent is asked to create -- and its workspace mounts no `/hub`, so there is no repository content for the two arms to read the same way. What both arms do read before any upload is the identity they will upload UNDER: `upload_folder` resolves the namespace from whoami, and a repository created under the wrong owner is the failure this pairs against. The MCP arm asks upstream's own huggingface server, which is `mcp-remote` pointed at the fake's MCP port; the mirage arm asks the `hf` CLI over the same fake. Both answer in prose, in different prose, so each side names the sed that reaches the same fact.

cases.name: hub_identity
cases.why: the account the upload namespaces under; both arms authenticate with the task's own name as the bearer, and the fake reads the bearer as the tenant

cases.name: hub_orgs
cases.why: the org memberships the same identity carries, which upstream prints and this CLI dropped until it was fixed -- an agent that cannot see its orgs cannot choose to push to one
